metadata.hypothesis_title: Bidirectional Thalamocortical Coupling and Structural Morphology in Insomnia

critic_findings.message: All statistical tests failed due to insufficient data (n=0) across all modalities, likely due to missing data in DTI, EEG, MRI, and scales.
critic_findings.recommendation: Improve data collection to ensure presence of DTI, EEG, MRI, and scales data for all subjects.

critic_findings.message: Spearman correlation was used as primary analysis, but linear regression might be more appropriate for modeling relationships between FC and sleep metrics.
critic_findings.recommendation: Revise analysis to use linear regression as primary model.
